description: After a CMS or catalogue save, apps/admin (lib/storefront-cache.ts) asks apps/web (app/api/revalidate) to drop its cached reads. This is the only HTTP call between the two apps. Written by the consumer; apps/web/testing/contracts verifies the provider against it. `{{secret}}` is STOREFRONT_REVALIDATE_SECRET, the same value in both apps.

interactions.name: a cache ping carrying the shared secret
a cache ping with the wrong secret
